status: synthetic design assumption; not a manufacturer preset or measured spray head
provenance: Hand-selected footprint parameters evaluated with the reconstructed EPS delta operator. Mechanism names organize candidate conditions; they do not implement atomization physics.
intended_behavior: thin elongated fan with flat core and sharp edges
assumptions: All numerical parameters are project design choices, not manufacturer or physical measurements.
Common camera, sampling, flux scale and angular/distance rules isolate selected footprint-shape differences; integrated deposition is not normalized.
The fixed software flux scale is not a measured paint flow rate.
The common inverse-square and incidence rules are uncalibrated model assumptions for every family.
Only a local relative-deposition surrogate is provided; no full-mechanism or real-device equivalence is claimed.
not_modelled: electrostatic fields, wraparound and Faraday-cage effects
measured transfer efficiency or real fluid flow
solid tool geometry, TCP calibration and robot kinematics
fidelity_limits: 82 archived original-library cases validate only those historical operator inputs; these new profiles have no new original-DLL reference.
Full native EPS scene equivalence is unverified.
All dimensions and intensity parameters are hypothetical; output is not micrometre film thickness.
